description: Static per-platform action-type vocabulary (web/android/ios/api/database/mainframe), used for offline draft validation. No network call. NOTE mainframe is deliberately EMPTY (no source list exists), and validate.ts skips validation entirely for an empty catalog — so a clean mainframe draft means "not checked", not "checked and fine".

platform.description: desktop: there is no offline list; on SimplifyQA the live catalog includes the DESKTOP actions (dsk-*: Launch Application, Click, Type Text, Switch to Window by Name, …).

name: actions_catalog
title: List the offline action-type catalog
